skill.name: seo-meta-optimizer
skill.description: Creates optimized meta titles, descriptions, and URL suggestions based on character limits and best practices. Generates compelling, keyword-rich metadata. Use PROACTIVELY for new content.
skill.summary: Creates SEO metadata packages with URL, title, and description recommendations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The reported command execution and network reconnaissance patterns are false positives from markdown formatting and SEO wording. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious workflow was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses inline markdown backticks around a resource path. It instructs the agent to open a documentation file, not execute a shell command.
Lines 73-77 are a fenced markdown output example for URL, title, and description text. There is no shell language marker, command, or executable instruction.
Lines 51-52 discuss adding numbers or a year to title tags for freshness and brand placement. This is SEO copy guidance, not network scanning or reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Search snippets often underperform because titles, descriptions, and URLs lack focus. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create concise metadata with keyword placement, calls to action, and variation options.
actual_capabilities: Creates URL structure recommendations with short, lowercase, keyword-focused slugs.
Drafts title tags with primary keywords, emotional triggers, and brand placement.
Writes meta descriptions with benefits, secondary keywords, and clear calls to action.
Provides character count validation for titles, descriptions, and URLs.
Generates at least three A/B test variations for metadata elements.
Suggests platform settings for WordPress, Astro, and Next.js SEO metadata.
limitations: It does not crawl websites or inspect live search results by itself.
It needs page content, target keywords, and brand context for best results.
It cannot guarantee ranking improvements or click-through rate gains.
Pixel width estimates may vary across devices and search interfaces.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Article
use_cases.description: Create title tags, descriptions, and URL slugs before publishing a blog post.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Pages
use_cases.description: Generate search snippets that highlight benefits, keywords, and buying intent.

use_cases.title: Prepare SEO Component Copy
use_cases.description: Turn page requirements into metadata fields for WordPress, Astro, or Next.js.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Meta Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO meta package for this page. Include one URL slug, one title tag, one meta description, and character counts.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword Variation Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these primary and secondary keywords to create three metadata variations. Explain the keyword placement and the intended search intent.

prompt_templates.title: Platform Publishing Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Create metadata for this page and map it to WordPress Yoast, RankMath, Astro, or Next.js fields. Include validation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Metadata Refresh Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for an existing page set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these existing titles, descriptions, and URLs. Identify weak snippets, rewrite them, and prioritize changes by likely impact.

output_examples.input: A SaaS pricing page for workflow automation software, targeting workflow automation pricing.
output: Title: Workflow Automation Pricing - Plans That Scale | Brand
Description: Compare workflow automation pricing, features, and team plans. Choose the right package and start improving operations today.

output_examples.input: A product page for waterproof hiking boots, targeting waterproof hiking boots.
output: Title: Waterproof Hiking Boots for All-Weather Trails | Brand
Description: Shop waterproof hiking boots built for traction, comfort, and wet trails. Find your fit before the next trip.

output_examples.input: An educational guide about technical SEO audits, targeting technical SEO audit checklist.
output: Title: Technical SEO Audit Checklist for Faster Fixes | Brand
Description: Use this technical SEO audit checklist to find crawl, index, speed, and metadata issues. Start with the highest-impact fixes.

best_practices: Provide the page goal, target audience, primary keyword, secondary keywords, and brand name.
Ask for several variations when search intent or tone is uncertain.
Review character counts and mobile truncation notes before publishing metadata.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for keyword stuffing or repeated exact-match phrases.
Do not use vague page descriptions without product, audience, or benefit details.
Do not publish generated metadata without checking brand voice and legal claims.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates SEO URL suggestions, title tags, meta descriptions, variation sets, character checks, and platform guidance.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it inspect live search engine results?
faq.answer: No. It works from the page content, keywords, and context provided in the prompt.

faq.question: Can it create WordPress SEO settings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest Yoast and RankMath fields based on the metadata it creates.

faq.question: Can it help with Astro or Next.js pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare metadata guidance for Astro and Next.js page components.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better rankings?
faq.answer: No. It improves metadata quality, but search rankings depend on many content, authority, and technical factors.
